text:
emily (partnerships): quick sync — AcmeCloud joint webinar is Thurs 11/18 10am PT. Need to lock speakers, demo runbook, swag counts, and shipping cutoffs. who can present the Redwood demo?

tariq (sales): happy to intro + quick product pitch. can we keep the demo to 8 minutes?

jess (eng-demos): I can own the live demo but need a validated model + machine with GPU access. prefer to use Redwood Dedicated staging pool to avoid token limits. will do a dry run Wed morning.

emily (partnerships): perfect — @jess please confirm model and sequence length so infra can prep. also we need 30-45 min rehearsal slot next Wed.

jess (eng-demos): confirmed model = open-gpt-3.5-redwood (quantized). typical prompt length ~220 tokens, max 1024. will need 1x T4-ish capacity for warmup + 2x for demo if we do parallel queries.

emily (partnerships): noted. @sam can marketing handle slide deck + co-branded assets? need logos and 1 slide for partner about integration.

sam (marketing): yes — will draft slides. can we get AcmeCloud headshot + 2-sentence bio from Priya? also final slide needs CTA and sandbox link.

Priya (AcmeCloud): sending headshot and bio now. happy to do 7 mins on partner story and integration benefits.

emily (partnerships): speaker plan: Tariq 3m intro, Priya 7m partner talk, Jess 8m live demo, Tariq 4m Q&A host. keep total 25m plus 5m buffer.

sam (marketing): swag ask — AcmeCloud will co-fund. proposed order: 150 tees (mix S-XL), 400 stickers, 150 notepads, 50 demo postcards with QR codes. deadlines: print proofs by 11/1, ship to us by 11/10.

emily (partnerships): shipping: we need swag onsite day before. Redwood can ship from SF office warehouse. can logistics team convert to USPS/UPS expedited? estimated cost split with AcmeCloud okay.

sam (marketing): I'll arrange printer quotes today. need final logo placement by 10/27.

jess (eng-demos): demo runbook draft (short):
```
- Connect to Redwood Dedicated staging pool (dedicated-demo-01)
- Pull quantized model: open-gpt-3.5-redwood-q4
- Warmup: 5 requests of 50 tokens
- Live queries: scripted prompts (see /slides/demo-prompts.txt)
- Fallback: if latency > 800ms, switch to CPU-safemode model and narrate degradation
- Post-demo: collect verbatim prompt outputs for QA
```

jess (eng-demos): also need network whitelist for AcmeCloud IPs for the rehearsal. can infra open that?

emily (partnerships): infra pinged. Tariq please confirm attendee-facing registration page and CTA link for sandbox access.

tariq (sales): landing page is live in staging at /events/acme-webinar. CTA: "Try the integration" -> sandbox invite flow. will add tracking params.

sam (marketing): rehearsal schedule proposal: Wed 11/17 9:30am PT — 45m (full run + Q&A simulation). A/V check with vendor at 9:00am.

Priya (AcmeCloud): confirmed rehearsal time. we'll join 15 min early for co-hosting checks.

event-bot: calendar invitation created for full rehearsal Wed 2027-11-17 09:30 PT and webinar Thu 2027-11-18 10:00 PT.

emily (partnerships): final action items:
- jess: demo runbook + test command by 11/3 (jess to paste shell test)
- sam: finalize swag spec + vendor by 10/30
- tariq: finalize landing page CTA & tracking by 10/28
- Priya: send headshot + bio by EOD today
- infra: open whitelist and reserve dedicated-demo-01 by 11/5

jess (eng-demos): shell test I will use locally for rehearsal: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"model":"open-gpt-3.5-redwood-q4","input":"Hello demo","max_tokens":150}'
```

tariq (sales): perfect. small note — can we print a tiny sticker with a QR to the sandbox on each demo postcard? conversion wins.

sam (marketing): yep, QR printing included. will run final art by Priya + Emily for signoff.

emily (partnerships): thanks all. i'll consolidate action items and follow up with shipping addresses once Sam confirms vendor. :thumbsup:

Priya (AcmeCloud): thanks everyone — excited to co-host!

event-bot: reminder scheduled 2 days before event for hosts and 1 hour before for all registrants.
